title: Invoices
householdSearchHelp: Showing up to 25 matches. Search by household name to narrow the list.

saveError: Could not save. Reload the invoice and check for a pending payment before trying again.
refundHelp: The refund goes back to the original card. Pending refunds reserve the amount until Stripe resolves them.

chargeHelp: Confirm this charge to the household’s default saved card.
removeHelp: Remove this card from the household and detach it at Stripe. Future payments will need another card.
showLink: Show a link to copy or open
linkSent: Pay link sent to the household.
